CITY OF NEW YORK
DEPARTMENT OF CITYWIDE ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES (DCAS)
ADDENDUM NO. 1

SOLICITATION TITLE: Automated Vehicle Location (AVL) & Fleet Telematics Software Platform
PIN: 85626P0001
DATE OF ISSUANCE: October 20, 2026

TO ALL PROSPECTIVE PROPOSERS:
This Addendum No. 1 is hereby issued to modify the solicitation terms and answer bidder questions.

1. PROPOSAL SUBMISSION DEADLINE EXTENSION
The proposal submission deadline is hereby extended to December 1, 2026 at 2:00 PM EST.

2. AMENDMENT TO SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS
2.1 Commercial General Liability Insurance:
Section 3.3 is hereby amended. The minimum required Commercial General Liability coverage is reduced to $2,000,000 per occurrence.

2.2 Mandatory Pre-Proposal Conference:
A mandatory pre-proposal conference shall be held virtually on October 25, 2026. Attendance is mandatory for all prime proposers.

3. QUESTIONS AND OFFICIAL AGENCY ANSWERS
Q1: Can telematics hardware installation be scheduled outside normal municipal operating hours?
Answer: Yes. DCAS central repair facilities operate 24/7, and scheduled evening/weekend installations are encouraged to minimize out-of-service vehicle downtime.

Q2: Does DCAS accept FedRAMP Moderate or AWS GovCloud environments for telematics data storage?
Answer: Yes. FedRAMP Moderate and AWS GovCloud hosting environments fully satisfy City of New York cyber security standards.

Q3: Will the City consider an M/WBE participation goal reduction if specialized diagnostic harness manufacturing is required?
Answer: No. The 30% M/WBE subcontracting goal remains mandatory unless an approved Schedule B waiver is granted by the Agency Chief Contracting Officer.
